headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points on inflation concerns, but benchmark indices extended weekly gains for third week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment during the last trading day, causing Sensex to fall 289 points.
Gift Nifty signaled a weak opening ahead of Friday's market session.
Earlier mid-week rallies added significant investor wealth as Sensex surged over 1,300 points.
Strong momentum in PSU banking stocks helped maintain weekly market gains.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex slipped 289 points as markets reacted to inflation worries.
Despite the final session slip, NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their rally for a third consecutive week.
PSU Banks were the top sectoral gainers over the course of the weekly wrap.
Indian equities showed overall resilience across the week despite global developments such as the Nvidia crisis.
summary: On the last trading day, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed on domestic markets. However, benchmark indices NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their weekly rally for a third consecutive week. PSU banks emerged as top sectoral gainers as Indian equities remained resilient.
